title: You Give Love A Bad Name
comment: An absolute 80s rock classic. The energy and the chorus are completely unmatched! Excellent for code jams.

title: Show Me How to Live
comment: Chris Cornell's vocals and Tom Morello's riffs make this track a masterpiece of alternative rock.

title: Lover, You Should've Come Over
comment: One of the most beautifully written, emotional songs ever. Buckley's range is breathtaking.

title: Running In Circles
comment: Super unique gritty rock sound with incredibly catchy bass lines and dynamic vocal shifts.
